name: Matsuno Osomatsu
source:
The oldest and leader of the sextuplets, as well as the best fighter in the group. His name comes from osomatsu (お粗末), which means lame or ill-prepared in Japanese. He is often immature and self-centered, and often gets on his brothers' nerves. He has a standard expression and often dresses in red.

[From Wikipedia]
